scope: Bounded coverage-preserving Go scheduling changes; no runner/workflow infrastructure, deletions, skipped assertions or tier moves.
method: Download recent full first-attempt Go artifacts with gh run download RUN --pattern go-*-tier-measurements; parse JSONL terminal pass events. Rank 4699 observed top-level cases by mean of available observations across two runs; nested cases are not added to parent costs. Artifacts include all seven Go shards and timing lane, all exitCode=0, attempt=1, full=true. This is observed coverage, not an assertion of all-platform catalogue completeness.

redundancyReview.finding: Shared 6000-row helper repeats baseline API assertions, but stale node_kinds statistics plus the subtree plan bound protect an additional real regression. They also run in the dedicated timing lane. No deletion/consolidation/tier move.
redundancyReview.retainedReplacement: both existing named tests at GATED-FULL

redundancyReview.finding: Same filtered seed and common HTTP assertions; stale-statistics case also bounds node visits and remains ESSENTIAL while the ordinary performance case is GATED-FULL in timing. Do not merge their tier identities or share a database across processes.
redundancyReview.retainedReplacement: both existing named tests at their existing tiers

redundancyReview.finding: Similar roughly 15-second waits do not establish duplicate coverage: invalid resume and live ping/counter preservation are distinct. Clock injection is a separate production change, outside this test-only reduction.
redundancyReview.retainedReplacement: both existing named tests at GATED-FULL

redundancyReview.finding: Large handover repeats lifecycle setup while ordinary handover tests authority, cycle and replay paths. Threshold/bounds coverage and authorization paths are distinct. Parallelize independent fixtures instead of deleting cases.
redundancyReview.retainedReplacement: TestCoordinatorHandover at ESSENTIAL and TestCoordinatorLargeHandover at GATED-FULL, with all 13 subcases

excludedParallelization.reason: Package-global pools plus reset(TRUNCATE tenants CASCADE); parallel cases would delete each other's fixtures.
Mutates http.DefaultTransport and slog.Default; protects attach refusal, authenticated local control and polling after restart. Four refusal cases and two generations remain serial.

archive.action: existing archive left untouched; no new deletions

measurement.runner: mbp2606, approved remote-test lane; GOMAXPROCS=8, package build cap=6, test parallel cap=2. Same runner/flags/database bootstrap on both commits.
measurement.firstAttemptGreen: Both actual targeted baseline and candidate executions returned exit 0, passed all identical 13 subcases, and reported no skips or failures. Earlier runner refusals and a command-quoting setup failure did not execute tests. This is the first-attempt evidence for the changed tests; broader validation setup failures and their successful retries are recorded separately.
measurement.limits: One before/after pair in the remote test lane. Package elapsed excludes Go compilation/listing/workflow setup. This is not a measured CI end-to-end improvement; noise/load and Postgres/runner versions limit extrapolation. Parallel parent terminal Elapsed excludes child wait, so compare parent run-to-pass timestamps and package elapsed instead.
measurement.criticalPathLimit: Both historical full runs had a different slowest Go shard (5 and 7). Reducing shard 4 alone is expected to save runner cost, not the full Go critical path in those snapshots. No end-to-end pipeline speedup is claimed.

releaseGate.sevenDayCheck: Seven days after merge, compare equivalent hosted shard-4 full first attempts and failures; confirm all 13 handover subcases still execute and revert the scheduling change if it regresses reliability.

ciStaticFirstAttempt.status: historical timeout failure, resolved by full retry with all 42 checks passing

fullHarnessFirstAttempt.reason: Remote helper does not generate ignored api/openapi.yaml in a fresh HEAD checkout. Generated it in the assigned temporary worktree; subsequent contract tests passed. Full rerun prepares this prerequisite at startup.

fullHarnessLatePreparation.reason: Manual contract generation landed after the early contract test had already run. All 273 other top-level tests passed. Final setup generates immediately on the guarded runner checkout-ready signal.

fullHarness.command: remote-test.sh WORKTREE -parallel 2 -json -count=1 ./internal/harness (generate api/openapi.yaml immediately when assigned checkout is ready)

catalogue.action: unchanged; no new/renamed/removed tests or tier moves, so no manifest rewrite
catalogue.coverageProof: before/after JSONL pass identities are identical for all 13 selected subcases; code diff only adds comments and two t.Parallel calls
catalogue.parallelismCap: existing tier runner fixes GOMAXPROCS=2; no Go runner or workflow changes

reproduceNote: Use the designated remote runner or the guarded local-heavy slot and an authorized test database. Quote shell patterns when invoking directly. Capture JSONL without exposing fixture values; compare parent run/pass timestamps or package elapsed after parallelization.

handoff.review: Normal cross-family PR review remains coordinator-owned; worker ran no model review.
